rules.logic: BIOC(MP-033 DirtyCoW firefart Account Created and Removed) AND BIOC(MP-033 pam_unix.so Written Outside the Package Manager) AND (BIOC(MP-033 Kernel-Thread-Named Process Restarted by a Watchdog Script) OR ABIOC(MP-033 GTP-C Port 2123 Listener Opened by a Non-Core Process)) AND (IOC(file-sha256 dnsd_el5) OR XQL(MP-033 CL-STA-0969 Toolkit sha256s Landed in panw_ngfw_threat_raw)) AND (BIOC(MP-033 Reverse SSH Tunnel to Remote Port 53) OR ABIOC(MP-033 NGFW Rare SSH Session from the Telecom Host)) joined on agent_hostname = endpoint_device_name (src_host) within 3600 seconds -> ONE incident
rules.name: CL-STA-0969 Telecom Intrusion — Endpoint + NGFW on src_host
